messages:
Alex Chen: Morning — quick async check-in for sales. Pipeline highlights: Aurelia Systems POC (private deployment) and BluePine pilot (hosted). Main blocker: Aurelia needs the on‑prem installer test and a completed security questionnaire by EOD to keep momentum. They also asked for network allowlist IPs and a redacted SOC2. @Jen Okafor can you advise who should share SOC2? @Nate Rivera can we get staging IPs and ports for the installer?

Maria Lopez: Aurelia update — expecting a signed DPA before next week. Sent questionnaire v2 to their team this morning, waiting on eng/security for technical answers. BluePine demo prep is on track for Thu, no blockers there.

Samir Patel: Quick product ask — Aurelia is asking for a 1-paragraph explanation of model isolation / tenant separation for their security team. Can eng provide something short we can paste into the RFP?

Jen Okafor: I can handle the SOC2 and questionnaire responses. Will redact and attach SOC2 summary later today. For the questionnaire I'll answer Q3 (data flow) and Q7 (encryption). Need the contact for their on-prem install test — who should I send it to?

Alex Chen: Vendor contact is Damian (damian@aurelia.io), CC me. He prefers afternoon PST windows this week.

Nate Rivera: Eng update — we can provide staging allowlist. Tentative IPs: `10.35.2.0/24` and `34.120.45.18`. Required ports for installer: 443 (HTTPS) and 22 (SSH for initial bootstrap). I'm still finalizing a tiny infra change, will confirm exact IPs in ~30–60m. Also can draft the 1-paragraph on model isolation (will include KV cache and per-tenant JVM/process isolation notes).

Maria Lopez: Please drop the confirmed IPs into the questionnaire doc once you have them — I'll publish back to the vendor.

Samir Patel: Another quick question for security: what's the default data retention policy we should tell them? 30 days cache + contract-configurable longer retention? @Jen Okafor

Jen Okafor: Yes — default retention is 30 days for KV cache and telemetry; persistent data retention is set per-contract. I'll add a line to the SOC2 summary and questionnaire answers.

Alex Chen: One more ask — can eng review the POC SOW this afternoon? It's small but they'd like a quick turnaround. @Nate Rivera

Nate Rivera: I can review after this check-in. ETA: 4pm PT. Will leave comments in the doc.

security-bot: New doc uploaded: https://internal.redwood/security/aurelia-questionnaire-v2 — checklist created and assigned to @Jen Okafor and @Nate Rivera.

Maria Lopez: Thanks everyone — if we get SOC2 redaction + confirmed IPs + questionnaire answers by EOD we should be green to move to contract. :crossed_fingers:

Alex Chen: Awesome, appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll follow up with Damian to schedule the installer window once IPs are confirmed. :thumbsup:
